candidate.answerReason: The segment is horizontal, so its length is \(|2-(-1)|=3\).

methods.label: Use the horizontal coordinate difference
methods.explanation: The y-coordinates are the same, so the distance is the absolute value of the difference between the x-coordinates, which is 3.
methods.levelReason: Uses the length of an axis-parallel segment, subtraction, and absolute value.
